# NG=F front-month Henry Hub futures: research notes as of 2026-10-08

**Summary:** The latest close I could find is about **$3.20/MMBtu on Oct 7 (November contract)**, and nothing settles the question yet. Several primary sources were unreachable through the proxy (Yahoo, EIA, AGA, Energy Intelligence), so a few figures below come from search snippets only. I left out every search result dated after 2026-10-08.

## 1. Resolution source
- Resolution uses the daily close of NG=F on Yahoo Finance for 2026-10-22, which is a Thursday and a normal trading day. I could not load the Yahoo page because the proxy refused the connection.
- The November 2026 contract (NGX26) expires 2026-10-28. That means NG=F will still be the November contract on Oct 22, and no contract roll happens before resolution. [TradingView contracts](https://in.tradingview.com/symbols/NYMEX-NG1!/contracts). The October 2026 contract (NGV26) expired 2026-09-28. [TradingView](https://in.tradingview.com/symbols/NYMEX-NG1!/contracts)
- 2026-10-07: Investing.com's NGX6 history showed a close of **3.203** (open 3.114, high 3.252, low 3.110, up 2.86%). This comes from a search summary; I could not fetch the page to confirm. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/commodities/natural-gas-historical-data)
- Investing.com lists a 52-week range of 2.483 to 7.827, but the snapshot date is unclear. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/commodities/natural-gas)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened that settles the question. It is two weeks out and the price is around $3.20.
- An undated APA report put the November contract at $3.03 after a 0.23% fall. It may be from early October, but that is not confirmed. [APA](https://en.apa.az/energy-and-industry/natural-gas-price-falls-on-new-york-exchange-528116)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-08: EIA reported an **85 Bcf** storage build for the week ended Oct 2, slightly above a 79 Bcf estimate. Total storage was 3,500 Bcf: 130 Bcf below last year and 68 Bcf above the 5-year average. [Oil & Gas 360](https://www.oilandgas360.com/weekly-gas-storage-10-2-2/)
- 2026-10-07: The November contract rose about 2.9% to roughly $3.20. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/commodities/natural-gas-historical-data)
- Early October 2026, EIA October STEO: one secondary source says EIA expects Henry Hub to average **$3.16 in 2027**, down 9% from 2026. The stated reason is above-average inventories, with production growth offsetting rising LNG exports. I could not open the primary PDF. [JM Financial](https://www.jmfinancialservices.in/market-news-and-insights/1735734), [EIA PDF](https://www.eia.gov/outlooks/steo/archives/oct26.pdf)
- 2026-08: The August STEO had forecast **$2.87 for 3Q26**, 50 cents below the July STEO. The July STEO had put the 2026 average at $3.67. [EIA Aug STEO](https://www.eia.gov/outlooks/steo/archives/aug26.pdf), [Rigzone](https://www.rigzone.com/news/usa_eia_raises_henry_hub_price_forecast_for_2026_2027-15-jul-2026-184139-article/?rss=true)
- Background themes for the season are LNG feedgas running near capacity, record-level production, and expectations of a strong El Niño, which tends to mean a milder northern-US winter. I could not find a dated pre-Oct 8 source for each of these.

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- Kalshi daily snapshots: Oct 1 was about 56% for being above $2.96, and Oct 5 was about 55% for being above $3.02. That suggests the front month traded near **$2.95 to $3.05 in early October**, then rose to about $3.20 by Oct 7. [Kalshi Oct 1](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxnatgasd/natural-gas-daily/kxnatgasd-26oct0117), [Kalshi Oct 5](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxnatgasd/natural-gas-daily/kxnatgasd-26oct0517)
- Kalshi Sep 30 monthly snapshot: about 72% above $2.80 and 44% above $3.00, so prices were around $2.95 to $3.00 in late September. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxnatgasmon/natural-gas-monthly/kxnatgasmon-26sep3017)
- Typical variation (my own rough estimate, not from a source): front-month gas implied volatility in October usually runs about 50 to 70% annualized. Over the 10 trading days from Oct 8 to Oct 22, that works out to a 1-standard-deviation move of roughly 10 to 14%, or about **±$0.30 to $0.45** from $3.20.
- Seasonal pattern: in shoulder season, prices are driven mainly by 2-week weather forecasts and weekly storage surprises. Daily moves of 3 to 6% are common.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi has a weekly market for Oct 16 (Oct 16 to 17), but its snapshot date is unclear, so I left out its odds. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxnatgasw/natural-gas-weekly/kxnatgasw-26oct1617)
- I could not find a Kalshi, Polymarket or Manifold market that resolves on the Oct 22 close itself, and Robinhood only has intraday markets.
- EIA's October STEO points to a 4Q26 Henry Hub spot average in the low $3s (from a secondary summary; the exact number is unverified). [EIA](https://www.eia.gov/outlooks/steo/archives/oct26.pdf)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **EIA storage reports** on Thu Oct 15 and **Thu Oct 22, 10:30 ET**. The second one is released on resolution day, before the close.
- Daily updates to the GFS and ECMWF weather models, plus NOAA's 6-10 and 8-14 day outlooks, will shape late-October and early-November heating demand.
- NOAA's winter outlook is usually released in mid-October. Its El Niño framing could push prices down.
- LNG feedgas swings, from plant maintenance or new capacity coming online, and late-season Gulf hurricanes.
- Production data, including whether output is at or near record levels.
- The November contract expires Oct 28, after resolution, but positioning ahead of expiry can make prices choppier in the days before Oct 22.
